note: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 67700fd37e. A new positive tag, TestDNSRemoteNATMismatchFloats (nat_dns_test.go), drives handleSAInitResponse for a peer named by DNS over a real encoded response: a NAT_DETECTION_SOURCE_IP hash that is not over the resolved address sets detected+peerBehindNAT and floats to 4500, and one over the resolved address changes nothing, so a check made against the configured name, or skipped, goes red. It carries a mutant record. The earlier units are unchanged and keep their records. Prior judgement: Rejudged 2026-09-30 (ike-eap judge). TestRFC7296InitiatorChecksEachNATDetectionPayload drives handleSAInitResponse over a real encoded IKE_SA_INIT response: a SOURCE_IP mismatch alone sets NATDetected+PeerBehindNAT and floats to 4500, a DESTINATION_IP mismatch alone sets NATDetected+BehindNAT and floats, so ignoring either payload goes red. TestRFC7296InitiatorCheckFindsNoNATOnMatchingPayloads (both present, both matching: no NAT, not floated) goes red if presence alone were taken as a NAT, i.e. if the payloads were not checked. Both carry observed-red records on fsm.go handleSAInitResponse. HEAD tags on transport TestNATDetectionPresent/Absent (DetectNAT in isolation) are supplementary and hold no record.
